name: Posterior Delta — append-only writer
description: Mechanical converter from chuck-v2/v3 family runner-execution receipts into schema-validated, append-only posterior delta records (chuck.posterior-delta.v1) plus read markers (chuck.read-marker.v1) when a prior capsule was injected into the executor prompt. Preserves family attribution + evidence pointers; never asks a model to merge into the shared prior. Salvages chuck-posterior-delta.mjs.

deltasDir.label: Posterior deltas dir
deltasDir.help: Where written deltas land. Reader subsystems (compaction gate, dashboard) consume from this dir.

readMarkersDir.label: Read markers dir
readMarkersDir.help: Where read markers land when the executor prompt was injected with a prior capsule. Read markers feed the prior compaction decision.
